name: report_decomposed_task_operations
description: Reports a complex task split into a list of simpler, self-contained group of operations. This is the final step after identifying all necessary individual operations.

operations.description: A list of self-contained, groups of operations derived from the original complex task. Each item in this list should be a cohere independent group of actionable steps.

explanation.description: An optional, concise explanation of how the task was split or the rationale behind the split operations.
